audit: tutienidle beta scope contract - consumer/integration seam audit
verdict: FAIL WITH REASON - 1 confirmed consumer-seam leak (Low), 2 latent open seams (coverage gaps, no live mint today). The codebase is otherwise comprehensively gated: every named consumer seam carries an explicit fail-closed scope check or is provably unreachable from dormant state.

findings.consumer_path: HomeBuildingIcons.vue:81 renders navigation.getBuildingStatus(buildingId) for every built building on the home map
findings.repro: tests/architecture/betaConsumerSeamsQa.qa.test.ts describe 'F-QA-CONS-BADGE-1' - two failing assertions: (1) a restored dormant-family alchemy job makes the badge read 'active' (expected: not 'active'); (2) with upgrade materials present the badge still reads 'active' (expected: 'upgradeable').
findings.mechanism: AlchemySystem.tick parks dormant-family jobs forever (AlchemySystem.ts:370-374, job pushed back into remaining). GameManagerAlchemyOps.getAlchemyJobs() (:114) returns the UNFILTERED getJobs() - including parked records. getBuildingStatus counts jobs.length > 0 -> 'active'. The two sibling consumers of the same record DO filter: getBetaAlchemyRecipeModels filters activeJobs through betaRecipeFamilyOfId (:401-403) and AlchemyView filters job list rows (:195). The badge is the only consumer that does not.
findings.user_impact: On a carried/flagged save with a parked dormant alchemy job, the pill_room nameplate shows 'active' permanently (the job can never settle), and the badge's priority ordering (locked > ready > active > upgradeable) suppresses the 'upgradeable' signal forever. Cosmetic surface lie; the upgrade itself still works through the popover.
findings.mint_path: None - cosmetic badge only. No effects, currencies, or items minted.
findings.mint_path_detail: gated record (parked dormant job) -> unfiltered consumer -> visible surface state. The defect class matches the contract definition (dormant scope leaking into visible play through a consumer path) but the mint is a badge string, not an effect.
findings.fix_hint: filter the job list the same way the panel does: gameManager.alchemyOps.getAlchemyJobs().some(job => betaRecipeFamilyOfId(job.recipeId) !== null)

findings.confidence: high (seam verified open; latent because no runtime ships the hook today)
findings.repro: tests/architecture/betaConsumerSeamsQa.qa.test.ts it 'F-QA-CONS-SURVIVE (LATENT)' - resolveCombatBuild with a hidden_spell save and a runtime stub implementing buildSurviveSources: expect(build.survive.extraSources).toBeUndefined() FAILS (binds the function).
findings.mechanism: Every other runtime channel routes through gatedRuntime = wayAdmitted ? runtime : undefined (roles :234, statDomains :235, buildDynamicBasic :242, resolveMaxThe :255). survive.extraSources alone binds the RAW `runtime` param, so a dormant way's runtime would mint hidden survive sources into battle on a carried save.
findings.mint_path: None today - no shipped runtime implements buildSurviveSources (CultivationPathRegistry.ts:495 'Beta: no buildSurviveSources'). The first dormant runtime to implement it leaks survive sources on carried saves.

findings.confidence: high (gate absence verified; latent because no hidden building produces today)
findings.consumer_path: building popover harvest button -> collectBuilding -> materialBag.add
findings.repro: tests/architecture/betaConsumerSeamsQa.qa.test.ts it 'collectBuilding on chi_hien_quan returns 0' PASSES today (control documenting no live mint). The structural gap: unlike buildBuilding/upgradeBuilding (:65,:78,:269 gated by isBetaBuildingSurface), collectBuilding and getBuildingStoredAmount carry no scope gate.
findings.mechanism: If a future scope-hidden building ever declares producesMaterialId, a carried instance would mint materials through collect, and 'ready' badges through getBuildingStoredAmount - both ungated.
findings.mint_path: None today - chi_hien_quan (the only scope-hidden building) has no producesMaterialId, so resolveProducesMaterialId returns undefined and both accessors short-circuit to 0.
findings.fix_hint: add `if (!isBetaBuildingSurface(instance.buildingId)) return 0` at the top of both accessors
